title: Generalized Kazakov-Migdal Models on Graphs via Artin-Ihara $L$-function and Random Partitions
summary: We introduce Kazakov-Migdal (KM)-type gauge theories on graphs via the Artin-Ihara $L$-function, providing a unified description of the models proposed in prior works. Using harmonic analysis on the group manifold, we reformulate the KM-type model on the cycle graph as a random partition model governed by the Schur measure.
